claims.definition: SUM(line_total) over orders with status Delivered or Processing; Cancelled and Returned excluded
claims.limitations: Synthetic, seeded dataset generated from standard retail distributions

claims.population: Distinct customers with at least one valid (Delivered/Processing) order, out of 2,000 customer records
claims.limitations: Excludes the 8 customers whose every order was Cancelled/Returned (inactive by the documented definition)

claims.formatted_value: 12,000 placed = 9,312 Delivered (77.6%) + 621 Processing (5.2%) + 844 Cancelled (7.0%) + 1,223 Returned (10.19% of placed)
claims.population: All placed orders; statuses mutually exclusive
claims.definition: Returned is its own exit (1,223), never subtracted from Delivered
claims.limitations: Delivered and Processing both count toward revenue; Cancelled orders never transacted

claims.population: Churn-risk Medium Risk band of the deployed churn model (n = 1,597)
claims.definition: Win-back audience per churn_features.csv risk band; EV ₹522.55 net revenue per contact, campaign EV ₹2.30L, break-even churn probability 12.54%
claims.limitations: Historical spend; win-back recovery is a simulated scenario, not a run campaign

claims.formatted_value: ROC-AUC ≈ 0.662 on the held-out split (5-fold CV 0.674)
claims.definition: Stratified holdout, not a temporal split; out-of-fold isotonic calibration moves Brier 0.1726 → 0.1715; PR-AUC 0.332 is the operative number at 23.5% prevalence
claims.limitations: A ranking/targeting tool, not calibrated probabilities without correction

claims.formatted_value: ₹6.45L margin recovered by a 10% discount cap (2.0% of total margin)
claims.population: Order line items by discount depth
claims.definition: Repricing scenario cap_10 — margin recovered vs status quo; break-even lift at 20% depth is +59.2%
claims.limitations: Observational — association, not causation; no statistically significant quantity response (Kruskal-Wallis p = 0.305)

claims.population: Benchmark v1.1 — 37 retail analytics questions, mode=fallback
claims.definition: Execution accuracy with independent pandas ground truth (computed from data/processed/master_orders.csv, never from the system under test); refusals scored separately
claims.limitations: 100% refusal correctness and 0 fabricated numbers on the benchmark; A13 fixed with regression test
